# bytes.Fields result that this repository still permits without a len() check in
# the same function, one `file:function # reason` per row. Every row carries the
# reason the data cannot be short. This list only shrinks: the class test
# (fieldsindex_class_test.go) fails on a row whose unchecked index has left as
# well as on an unchecked index that is not listed.
